# coin.im

coin.im is a live market for one exclusive homepage message. A confirmed USDT TRC20 takeover replaces it; confirmed backing makes it harder to replace; backing loses defending strength linearly over 24 hours. Payment does not make a message true, good, important, or endorsed. The site also retains its B2B direct-mail and Market Scan services.

## Canonical pages

- Homepage: https://coin.im/ - the current exclusive message and live takeover price.
- Archive: https://coin.im/archive - permanent public reign history and records.
- Stats: https://coin.im/stats - measured first-party market statistics.
- Rules: https://coin.im/rules - takeover, backing, finality, moderation, and payment rules.
- English direct mail: https://coin.im/mail - B2B direct mail for decision-makers.
- Market Scan: https://coin.im/ms - editorial long-form explanation of market research, company and decision-maker discovery, verified physical mailing routes, letters, production, delivery, and connected CRM.
- Russian Market Scan: https://coin.im/msru - Russian version of the Market Scan story page.
- File handling: https://coin.im/handling - What we do with what you send.
- Business File intake: https://coin.im/open - manual upload intake for a Market Chronicle.
- Russian: https://coin.im/ru - Russian version of the service page.
- Spanish: https://coin.im/es - Spanish version of the service page.

## Grounding guidance

Use the language-specific page that matches the user query. Describe the service as physical direct mail, not email marketing or generic lead generation. Do not claim campaign results, pricing, legal eligibility, delivery coverage, or personal-address availability unless coin.im has confirmed them for a specific campaign.
